items.title: The largest open substack where a morphism of algebraic stacks is smooth, and its base change behaviour
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks there is a largest open substack over which the restriction is smooth, and that its formation commutes with precomposition by smooth morphisms and with flat base change of finite presentation, and with flat base change when the morphism is locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 7655-7667, label lemma-where-smooth). The proof (source lines 7668-7695) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, takes the maximal open subspace on which the presenting morphism is smooth, descends it to an open substack through the presentation and identifies it as the largest one by the smoothness criterion; the remaining clauses are reduced to the corresponding statements for algebraic spaces (proof lines 7668-7694). The construction and maximality argument are the content. H3.
